targets.query:
from(bucket: "luftqualitaet")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "Temperature" or r["_measurement"] == "TEMP")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "BME" or  r["_field"] == "TYPK" or r["_field"] == "TYP_K" or r["_field"] == "SHT")
  |> drop(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> drop(columns: ["einheit"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
